# EDGAR fixtures (synthetic)

Invented issuers and accession numbers, shaped like the live responses observed 2026-09-26:
`fts_*.json` like `https://efts.sec.gov/LATEST/search-index` (efts full-text search) and
`formd_*.xml` like a Form D `primary_doc.xml` (schema X0708). Used by `test_funding_signals.py`;
no test touches the network.
